items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: Happy come out that band, Rayd Happy.

ctx.x: Oh, yes, I met him once, down in the 9th Ward on the Duzardi extreme.

Well, I went in that band playing drums too, in that band with Maurice Durand. And Jimbo had left the band, so they took London, Willie Umphrey was playing in the band, Clarence Willie. Yeah. When Willie left, then they took London Vare in the band. London Vare, Buddy Johnson, and Maurice Durand, that was a three-blowing instrument. So, they had Green playing guitar, Green, and I think they had T-Boy on bass. And they had a couple other drums, trying to see somebody else. I know I was playing from the first…
I never knew anything about him. You heard of him?
